title: Projecting sg sign
slide_intent: Use a compact identifier where the viewing format is narrow or oblique so a destination can be recognized along a street.
strategic_value: The sg monogram can give Sweetgreen a concise secondary street presence.
demonstration: A dark green projecting sign carries a large pale sg monogram within a dark metal frame.
practical_value: Compare the compact monogram with the full wordmark when a sign projects from a façade.

content_islands.name: Monogram panel
content_islands.spec: Center the large sg lettering on the green face.

content_islands.name: Mounting
content_islands.spec: Retain the projecting dark frame and wall connection.

reference_purposes.Application: The compact signature is used on a projecting storefront sign.
reference_purposes.Expression: Large overlapping letterforms create a distinctive abbreviated identifier.
